text: Last Monday morning, Bill Squires, an employee of radio station KOAM in Pittsburgh, Kansas,
reported a very strange experience to authorities.
Today, I spoke with him about it on long-distance telephone.
Here is the story as he told it to me.
Radio program at 6.50 every morning with exceptions.
And I always leave my house at, uh, even if it's at 530, uh, in order to be able to get out and make out my program.
And, uh, where I saw this object was, uh, just about a mile and a half from my house.
And I was traveling right north and south.
And I was going south, and I saw it on the west side of the road.

I don't know if it was sitting there, but the shape of it was as if you would take an old-fashioned platter and set it on the table right side up, and then turn another platter down over the top of it.
It was a dull, old-fashioned color.
What was the Italian with the roof to think?
Well, I would say, roughly speaking, and I was very excited, the hair on the back of my head was standing up, and I would say that it was 75 feet long and to me.
Now, was it on the ground?
No, sir.
Well, it was in the air.
and it was hovering, I would say, somewhere from 8 to 10 or possibly 12 feet
above the pompous grass squeezed to the bottom of this contractor.
Did you stop when you saw it?
Not immediately, because when I first saw it, I was north of it,
and I was on the driver's side, of course, and I looked through my right windshield and saw it.
And as I went on down, just about keeping with it, well,
and I opened the car door and as soon as I killed my motor, I could hear it.
And it was making a sound, something like this. It was going,
and as I got out of the car, it stood up.
It just took off and went back straight up.
And it sounded like a cubby of a hundred cranes over a table.
I saw some signs of life on the inside of it.
Well, there was blue lights out in the middle of this thing.
Through the windows, there was three or possibly four windows that I was looking at.
And there were blue lights, and they weren't black.
They were turned from a dark blue to a light blue, then a pale blue, and then maybe back to a light blue and a dark blue again.
